cleavage_agent.evidence: For all experiments, cells were harvested in ice-cold PBS, lysed in 6 M guanidine buffer, reduced and alkylated, and subsequently digested with Lys-C and trypsin.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphorylated peptides were enriched using TiO2 beads.

fractionation_method.evidence: Subsequently, samples were high-pH fractionated on StageTip.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Precursors were isolated with a width of 1.3 m/z, with an AGC target of 2e5 charges, and precursor fragmentation was accomplished using higher energy collision dissociation (HCD).

ionization_type.evidence: Electrospray ionization (ESI) was achieved using a Nanospray Flex Ion Source (Thermo), with the ions analyzed using a Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer (Thermo).

labeling.value: MS1 intensity based label-free quantification method

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: MS/MS spectra were acquired in the Orbitrap, and settings included a loop count of 9, a maximum injection time of 90 ms and a resolution of 45,000.

ptm.evidence: For the data search, all RAW files were analyzed using the freely available MaxQuant software (version 1.5.3.30). Default MaxQuant settings were used, with exceptions outlined below.
Protein N-terminal acetylation, methionine oxidation, and phosphorylation of serine, threonine, and tyrosine residues were included as potential variable modifications.
